title: ZeroPain
tagline: Zero-pain cross-chain account abstraction, using LayerZero & the Boop AA stack.
description:
This uses the Boop account abstraction stack in conjunction with LayerZero cross-chain message passing to enable sending arbitrary message to an account on a chain B from the account deployed at the same address on chain A.

I didn't have time to finish, I started late and configuring LayerZero took a lot of time :)
how_its_made:
Account Abstraction: uses the Boop stack (https://docs.happy.tech/boop)
Cross-chain message passing / interop: LayerZero
Code: Solidity, Typescript
Tooling: Foundry

I have really cool scripts for contracts deployments. I normally wouldn't speak about it but I have to ramble because we have to put characters in this box. Seriously, this is a pain in the neck, especially for those who didn't have time to finish their projects.
